entities.name: Mexicana de Aviación Flight 704
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: On 4 June 1969, Mexicana de Aviación Flight 704, a Boeing 727 airliner registered XA-SEL, crashed near El Carmen, some 20 miles north of the city of Monterrey, Nuevo León. All 79 people on board were killed.
